  • Outstanding Shopping Experience!
    11 Jan
    love you guys keeeep going

    I have been a loyal customer of Nice One for quite long time now, and I'm consistently impressed with the quality of their products and the level of service they provide. The website's user-friendly interface makes it a breeze to find exactly what I need, and their extensive selection of makeup and skincare items is truly impressive. Every purchase I've made has been promptly delivered within one day or some times same day and the products always exceed my expectations. The customer service team is also top-notch; they're friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to assist with any inquiries. I highly recommend Nice One to anyone looking for high-quality makeup and skincare products, coupled with a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience!" Thank you Nice One team

  • Thank you so here you go!
    26/09/2023
    Aalia H.

    The store is really helpful and amazing but have couple of points that might help building your customer experience: - Increase the number of products offered at the same category as when customers are presented with option they tend to buy a lot more to explore. - Lose the web based user experience and provide native app experience - Searching tool (smart searching) can be enhanced which lead to more customer engagement - Offer more brands and insight tool about using the product - Enrich the existing offered products with related products that can be used with I’m a makeup and digital transformation enthusiast and would love to see Saudi brand going global, all the best 👍🏽

  • One of my best 🔥
    22/10/2024
    tjx9_

    I really like the ease of dealing with this application, the condition of the products upon arrival, the packaging and the speed of delivery. Everything is great. The offers and different payment methods make it superior to other applications. But as a technician, I see some technical flaws in searching and filtering. It does not give all the results. Sometimes you have to write the full name of the product in order for it to appear. Thank you for your efforts and I hope that your service will continue at the same great level as it is now. 💗💗💗

  • About out of the stock products
    12/04/2023
    shima UX UI specialist

    Great user experience, 4/5 , just because whenever I purchase a product, it doesn’t tell me it is out of stock ! It keeps loading which makes the user confusing. Is it going to add on my bag? Or my Internet connection is not working? That is my major dislike, You need to update your products, if it is not available, do not put it in my basket then tell me it’s not there!
